verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents Service Accounts as its recommended authentication mechanism and publishes a Service Accounts API spec, so it offers dedicated non-human credentials an agent could use. Nothing in the evidence shows these credentials can be scoped to specific projects, roles or permissions, so the least-privilege part of the story is unproven. missing for 10: documented per-credential scopes/roles or permission limits, project-level restriction of service accounts, MCP/agent-specific credential scoping, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: the recommended authentication mechanism going forward
Every Mixpanel API is described by an OpenAPI specification.
